_hookPathNote: Hooks go through .claude/hooks/dispatch.sh, which resolves this repo's root and runs the named hook. The candidate roots and the reason they exist are documented there, not here. Each entry below only has to locate the dispatcher.

hooks.command: sh -c 'for d in "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/ArenaURP; do [ -x "$d/.claude/hooks/dispatch.sh" ] && exec "$d/.claude/hooks/dispatch.sh" session-start.sh; done; echo "hook dispatcher not found: session-start.sh" >&2'
